coordinates.frame: Fusion root frame. All files in model/ share it, so they line up when loaded together.
coordinates.x: Across the device. The casing spans 92.56 to 135.13.
coordinates.y: Along the device. Knob end at y=-5, USB end at y=80.
coordinates.z: Up. The flat base with the lid opening is at z=0, the rounded ridge at z=39.02.
coordinates.cross_section: Rounded triangle: flat base, speaker behind the -X wall, LilyGo board in the +X window, battery along the base.

assembly.note: Holds the TP4057 board at the USB end. Design-of-record sokkel; variants A-D are in print/2026-10-29_tp4057_sokkel.
Fusion calls this body 'Audio'. Identified as the MAX98357 from its place next to the speaker and INVENTORY.md; the design does not say so.
A plain 53.9 x 25 x 2 slab tilted 60 degrees, not a model of the board. Despite the Fusion name it is not 62 long. For the real board's extent see lilygo reference under excluded_third_party.
Self-made stand-in from before the V6 sokkel. See known_model_issues.

print_layout_parts.note: Laid out flat for printing, not in their assembled position. The design does not record where they sit assembled.

not_modelled.note: In the device per INVENTORY.md, but there is no body for it in the design.

excluded_third_party.what: 'Charging Module TP4057 Mini' community STEP model, placed in the device
excluded_third_party.note: The accurate TP4057 extent. Use these bounds rather than tp4057_board for fit work.

excluded_third_party.what: LilyGo reference mesh, hidden in the design. It is the touch variant; the device uses the non-touch board.
'Knob - Rotary encoder EC11 15mm' by Pokzy, not part of the device layout

known_model_issues.issue: Stand-ins overlap, which does not reflect the real device.
Lid seat is not pinned down. The base opening at z=0.5 spans x 102.6 to 125.1 and y 3.15 to 74.5 (22.5 x 71.35). The lid is 22.29 x 68.5, so the width fits but its position along y is not recorded.
